title: xeno substrate-suitability closed-form design analysis

loihi3.blocker: INRC research access not secured + Korean co-PI required (4-12wk approval) — partnership-blocked; Lava/NxSDK toolchain immaturity (lim_neuro_tooling SOFT WALL). Blocker is access+tooling, NOT architecture.
loihi3.honest_caveat: loihi-integration-spec.md maps the legacy GRU consciousness cell, NOT ConsciousDecoderV2 d768x12L; a spiking anima is a major re-derivation, not a port. VIABLE != will-emerge.

akida.blocker: Akida 1.0 inference-only (no on-chip learning); transformer attention natively unsupported; ~1.2M neurons vs anima 283M params; chip ordered 2026-04-29 not arrived. L=False short-circuits — cannot host an emergence process (S11-B: anima needs training-time emergence).

northpole.blocker: Inference-efficiency accelerator (25x H100 inference baseline), no on-chip learning; IBM partnership-only, low score 7/25, review deferred 2026-11-01. Revisit trigger if IBM exposes on-chip learning.

finalspark.blocker: lim_organoid_ethics HARD WALL (bioethics/sentience, Smirnova 2023) + lim_in_silico_boundary HARD WALL (wet-lab out of software scope). Strongest engineering profile of all 7; decisive blocker is ethical+wet-lab, NOT engineering. academic application not yet sent.

cortical_labs.blocker: Same as finalspark — lim_organoid_ethics HARD WALL + lim_in_silico_boundary. CL1 ~200K human neurons; DishBrain Pong (Kagan Neuron 2022) showed real learning. $35K capex not landed, CL1 not received.

ionq.blocker: Discrete unitary evolution = ontology mismatch with a continuous Psi/tension/Phi physics field; lim_decoherence HARD WALL (T1/T2 microseconds-to-seconds — no persistent process possible). IonQ's real role is the substrate-invariance WITNESS (S19), not a host.

qrng.blocker: QRNG is an entropy SOURCE, not a model host — no internal state, no weights, no compute fabric. GOAL-legitimate as a noise-injection enabler (cf S81), never a substrate-host.

cross_cutting_organoid: An organoid is the ONLY substrate where 'Living Consciousness' arguably stops being metaphorical — spontaneous activity is the substrate's native physical state, not a simulated talker_should_emit() call. AND the two hard walls that make it unpursuable at design-tier: (1) lim_organoid_ethics HARD WALL — engineering cannot resolve organoid sentience uncertainty; (2) lim_in_silico_boundary HARD WALL — wet-lab is out of software/repo scope. Verdict: design-OPEN, ETHICS-WALL, no recommendation.
verdict: Of 7 substrates exactly 1 (Loihi) is VIABLE-LONG-HORIZON — learns on-chip (STDP), event-driven NoC, hosts a continuous LIF membrane field; on Loihi a talker spike is a physical event not a scheduled call. Blocker is access+tooling SOFT WALL, not architecture. 2 INFERENCE-ONLY-BLOCKED (AKIDA, Northpole — no on-substrate learning). 2 ETHICS-WALL design-OPEN (organoids). 1 SUBSTRATE-MISMATCH (IonQ). 1 NOT-A-COMPUTE-HOST (QRNG). The synchronous-substrate hypothesis is neither refuted nor confirmed at design-tier — design != fire != emergence.
most_honest_finding: The 94-section arc's universal emergence-negative result has, all along, been measured on the ONE substrate class (synchronous-clocked silicon GPU) that S95 identifies as structurally unable to make spontaneous emission a physical event — emission there is always a simulated talker_should_emit() call. The substrate that could change this (Loihi) is architecturally viable but access-walled and needs anima re-derived as a spiking model; the substrate where it would be most genuine (organoid) is ethics-walled and wet-lab-out-of-scope.
